title: 空间先验优于语义提示：基于网格的方法提升LLM图表数据提取精度
summary: 本文对比了语义提示与空间先验两种策略对多模态LLM从科学图表中提取数据的影响。实验表明，在图表上叠加坐标网格的空间先验方法能显著降低提取误差（SMAPE从25.5%降至19.5%），而高级语义引导（如元数据优先框架、思维链）未带来统计显著提升。结论：对于当前多模态模型，显式空间上下文比高级语义指导更有效。
summary_en: This paper compares semantic priming vs. spatial priming for multimodal LLMs in chart data extraction. Results show that overlaying a coordinate grid significantly reduces error (SMAPE from 25.5% to 19.5%), while high-level semantic methods (metadata-first, CoT) show no significant improvement. Explicit spatial context is more effective than semantic guidance for current multimodal models.
